name: Card pipeline
description: Refine ClickUp cards with the biz-gate agent (evidence first, drafts before posting), then run the card pipeline flow in Studio.

settings.label: Team knowledge file
settings.help: Absolute path to your team's private biz-gate file: projects, business rules, comment language. See examples/team-knowledge.example.md.

settings.label: Repos folder
settings.help: Absolute path to the folder holding your team's repos.

settings.label: ClickUp workspace id
settings.help: The number after app.clickup.com/t/ in a card link.

settings.label: ClickUp board id
settings.help: The saved board id in the clickup-board plugin (mctl clickup boards).

settings.label: Planning field id
settings.help: The custom field that holds the sprint.

settings.label: AI sprint pattern
settings.help: Regular expression for the AI sprint options, e.g. ^Sprint (\d+) ?AI\b

settings.label: Comment footer
settings.help: Last line of every bot comment, so people know a bot wrote it.
